items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Rosetta was able to come in and Saturday, 12:00, and interviewed me and we had a lovely interview... I've enjoyed her immensely.

ctx.x: The day that Rosetta come here, she come here the day after the power was restored back to my home. This is Sippie Wallace talking and Lord, the storm had everybody's heat cut off and lights cut off and everybody, everybody, was stranded for heat and cold. Lord was good, got the heat come back and Rosetta was able to come in and Saturday, 12:00, and interviewed me and we had a lovely interview and had made a lovely tape. And we had a -- we came back church and seen a beautiful musical and came back to my home and…

I never will forget that good music that me and Little Brother -- I'm telling you true, girl, I sure did enjoy that that Hocile singing. It sounds just like it was yesterday. It sounds just like it was only yesterday that all this good stuff was going on and I never will forget it. It was wonderful. And I hope you enjoyed yourself, too.
